prompt:
Fix snippets/presale-access-gate.liquid, which renders a pre-sale access message. Defaults must be applied correctly. Inputs (all top-level variables, none under section.settings): - presale_label: string or null. - gate_enabled: boolean or null. - min_orders: integer or null. 0 is a valid value. - customer_orders: integer or null. null means a guest who is not logged in. 0 is a logged-in customer with no orders. - customer_tags: array of strings, never null, may be empty. - vip_tag: string or null. Defaults and normalization: - LABEL: strip leading and trailing whitespace from presale_label. If the result is empty, or presale_label is null, use "Early Access". - Gate: if gate_enabled is null, treat it as true. An explicit false must stay false. - Required orders: if min_orders is null, use 1. An explicit 0 stays 0. - VIP tag: if vip_tag is null or the empty string, use "vip". The VIP tag is not stripped. Output rules (first matching rule wins; LABEL is always passed through the escape filter): 1. Gate is false: output

LABEL is open to everyone

2. customer_orders is null: output

Log in to access LABEL

3. customer_tags contains an element exactly equal to the VIP tag (case-sensitive, whole tag, not substring), or customer_orders is greater than or equal to the required orders: output

Welcome to LABEL

4. Otherwise let N = required orders minus customer_orders. Output

Place N more order to unlock LABEL

. Use "order" when N is 1 and "orders" otherwise. Output nothing else: no whitespace or newlines before, after or between elements. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/presale-access-gate.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
